summary: Activity Stream feature (backend + frontend) tested end-to-end. 13/13 backend tests pass covering scope=tree|global|self, limit param, actor enrichment, and activity logging triggers (post_created, job_posted, review_given, position_changed, anonymous review suppression, tree-scope cross-user visibility). Frontend ActivityStream component renders on both /alumni/feed (with 3 tabs) and /alumni/tree (compact). All 9 kinds display with correct emojis; clicking an item navigates to profile; refresh + tab switching work.
critical_code_review_comments: Review upsert behavior in alumni_phase2.post_review only logs activity on first creation (new_review=True). If a user re-reviews the same subject, no activity is logged even though the rating/comment changed. Consider logging a 'review_updated' activity or re-logging 'review_given' on material changes. Not a bug, just UX nuance.

ActivityStream.jsx useEffect has empty catch block (`catch {}`) at line 45 — errors from /activity/stream API calls are silently swallowed; consider surfacing an error state so users know when the feed is stale (currently just shows empty state).

Tree-scope actor_id list uses `$in` with potentially large arrays (direct relations + BFS descendants/ancestors up to depth 8 + siblings). For large trees consider adding an index on alumni_activities.actor_id + created_at for the sort performance.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST-prefixed posts/jobs/reviews/position updates for student1. `clean_student_bas_review` fixture uses pymongo to purge existing review before non-anon/anon review trigger tests to allow fresh insert path. No destructive changes to seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_activity_stream.py (13 tests, all pass in ~10s). Activity kinds verified: post_created, job_posted, review_given (non-anonymous only), position_changed. Not directly verified via dedicated test: joined_family, company_changed, tree_extended (relation confirm), level_up, badge_earned — but endpoint shape/scope tests pass and these use the same _log_activity helper now wired into alumni.py at lines 303, 315, 531, 571, 577, 784. Frontend verified on /alumni/feed (with tabs) and /alumni/tree (compact). Activity item click routes to /alumni/profile/{actor.user_id}. Review upsert path: _log_activity only triggers on new review creation; repeat reviews by same reviewer/subject won't log a new activity.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were in the test script itself (wrong endpoint /alumni/posts vs /alumni/feed/posts, missing 'kind' field in PostCreate, 'stars' vs 'rating' field name, and the upsert-on-duplicate-review semantics blocking activity log on 2nd review). All were fixed in the test script without modifying product code.
